en: A black-and-white historical photograph shows a snow-covered street or path lined with bare trees and wrought-iron fencing. The scene is bustling with people, mostly children, riding traditional wooden sleds downhill. Some adults are standing by the fencing, observing. The architecture and style of sleds, clothing, and general atmosphere indicate a European winter scene from the early 20th century. There is a house or small building at the top of the slope, and handwritten text at the bottom right, partially visible.
